items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Now when Clemens would play and the job would call for more pieces, Clemens would play the bass and the trombone, so they would use Joan Ranker on the trombone and Clemens, what they would call him Fire, would play the bass violin.

ctx.x: Not the Clemens that you know. It's a large well brother. What's his name? Oh, Teffle. Clemens Teffle. Yeah, he's, no, it couldn't be. That was her brother. Who? Oh, she's not talking about. Clemens.
